title: Office of Naval Intelligence reports; Tim Gallaudet on USOs

tellings.quote: that wrote up these reports. Tim Galedet talks a lot about you know some interesting usos you know identified submersible objects.

plain: Jesse Michels mentions reports written by the Navy's intelligence office, and says a retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet talks a lot about USOs, unidentified submersible objects, meaning craft seen moving under the sea. Michels raises it in passing himself, as a pointer that the Navy has records of strange objects in the ocean as well as the sky.
